outcome_field_semantics.official_result: Immutable exact settlement result for the recorded pregame player/event/stat/line/direction.
outcome_field_semantics.actual_value: Official settled scalar value when the market has a meaningful numeric outcome; otherwise null.
outcome_field_semantics.signed_distance_to_threshold: Positive when the selected scalar side cleared the exact recorded threshold, negative when it missed, zero at the numerical boundary; null for non-scalar markets.
outcome_field_semantics.close_miss_flag: Diagnostic metadata only. A loss remains a loss. Requires a lane/market-specific tolerance rather than a universal cutoff.
outcome_field_semantics.close_miss_tolerance: Explicit market-aware threshold used for close-miss classification; null means no close-miss classification was attempted.
outcome_field_semantics.duplicate_thesis_count: Count of exact or exposure-family instances recorded for postmortem structure attribution; never a probability haircut.
outcome_field_semantics.cards_killed: Count of cards for which this losing thesis was a necessary failed hinge.
outcome_field_semantics.critical_leg_rank: Pregame structural critical-leg rank when recorded; 1 is the largest modeled card-failure contributor.
